findings.claim: The row mis-states the grammar of the neighbouring span in device_notes, incompatibly with the embedded next row, and mis-states the extent of the curse-chain it argues in boundary_rationale.
grounds: device_notes asserts that the imprecatory register continues into web:Ps.109.14-Ps.109.20 'under different grammar (a motive clause replaces the jussive chain there)'. The bytes contradict the replacement: MT 109:14 opens יִזָּכֵ֤ר, MT 109:15 opens יִהְי֣וּ, and MT 109:19 opens תְּהִי — all jussive — while the motive clause יַ֗עַן אֲשֶׁ֤ר stands at MT 109:16 alone. The embedded neighbour row M8-Ps-371 argues that same span FROM יִזָּכֵ֤ר as its opening jussive and treats יַ֗עַן אֲשֶׁ֤ר as one member of a remembrance-root chain, so the two rows characterise 109:14-20 incompatibly. Separately, boundary_rationale calls the chain 'bounded by a fatherless-root inclusio' at oshb:Ps.109.9 and oshb:Ps.109.12, but that pair bounds neither the row's span (Ps.109.6-Ps.109.13) nor the chain, which is already jussive at MT 109:8 (יִֽהְיֽוּ) after the imperative הַפְקֵ֣ד at MT 109:6 and is still jussive at the row's own closing verse, MT 109:13 יְהִֽי אַחֲרִית֥וֹ לְהַכְרִ֑ית. Not alone load-bearing: the 13|14 seam stands on the byte-true generational reversal at MT 109:14 (אֲ֭בֹתָיו).
findings.proposed_change: Field repair, no respan. device_notes: replace 'a motive clause replaces the jussive chain there' with the byte-true differentiator — the kinship reversal to אֲ֭בֹתָיו at MT 109:14, with the motive clause located at MT 109:16 only. boundary_rationale: describe oshb:Ps.109.9 / oshb:Ps.109.12 as an interior fatherless-root echo rather than a bounding inclusio. Seam-pair discipline: any device_notes cure is installed on both M8-Ps-370 and M8-Ps-371.
